name: esg-hub
notes: Next.js standalone release copied into the image and run as `node server.js` with uid 994 (the esghub user the systemd unit used). The eleven credentials stay on the node in /etc/esg-hub/esg-hub.env and arrive through --env-file; Docker keeps quotes literally where systemd strips them, so a normalised copy is written to /run before the start. The prerender cache in .next/cache is container-local, so it rebuilds on restart — a deliberate consequence of the no-node-state rule. Published to GHCR and pinned by digest (2026-10-27, tag lean-test): 115 MB packed, against 326 MB for the first build, because .next/cache is dropped and the tree is copied once with --chown instead of twice.
